title: A block on the ground, off its axis
model: a 20 x 20 x 40 mm steel block on a frictionless contact support, 4 kN down at b/12 off its axis (a remote load on its top); 4 mm elements, 2 increments

peak_pressure.source: the short column's kern: sigma_max = P/A (1 + 6e/b) for e within b/6 (Timoshenko & Gere, Mechanics of Materials, the core (kern) of a section under an eccentric axial load)
peak_pressure.reason: a block four times as tall as its base's eccentricity spreads its load to the linear pressure the formula assumes; the contact's penalty lets the base sink a hundredth of the element, and the peak is a corner node's, which the 4 mm mesh reads to a few tenths of a percent
